test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: ‘Running for My Life: One Lost Boy’s Journey from the Killing Fields of Sudan to the Olympic Games’ an autobiography depicting the struggle for life to success in life is written by who among the following personalities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lopez Lomong**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lopez Lomong**, the author of the autobiography **“Running for My Life: One Lost Boy’s Journey from the Killing Fields of Sudan to the Olympic Games,”** narrates his journey from being a refugee to an Olympian.
 
• He was one of the **“Lost Boys of Sudan,”** a group of over 20,000 boys displaced or orphaned during the Second Sudanese Civil War (1983–2005).
 
• Born in **Kimotong, South Sudan,** Lomong was abducted at the age of six by soldiers from the Sudanese People's Liberation Army and escaped after three weeks of captivity.
 
• He fled to a refugee camp in **Kenya** and later resettled in the **United States** through a foster care program.
 
• Lopez Lomong eventually became a U.S. citizen and represented the United States in the **2008 Beijing Olympics** and the **2012 London Olympics.**
 
• The book is a profound account of his struggles with **poverty, war, and displacement** and his ultimate triumph in achieving his dreams through perseverance and hard work.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Noah Lyles**__

 __
 
• **Noah Lyles** is an American professional track and field athlete specializing in **sprints.**
 
• He is a **World Champion** in the 200 meters and holds multiple titles in the **World Athletics Championships.**
 
• While he is a celebrated sprinter, he is not the author of the autobiography in question.
 
 
 
• **Jesse Owens**__
 __
 
• **Jesse Owens** was a legendary American track and field athlete who won **four gold medals** in the **1936 Berlin Olympics.**
 
• He is known for breaking racial barriers in sports during a time of significant prejudice.
 
• Although Owens wrote an autobiography titled **“The Jesse Owens Story,”** he did not write “Running for My Life.”
 
 
 
• **Arnold Palmer**__
 
 
• **Arnold Palmer** was a world-renowned American **professional golfer,** regarded as one of the greatest in the sport’s history.
 
• He was a seven-time **major championship winner** and a key figure in popularizing golf in the 20th century.
 
• While Palmer authored several books on golf and his career, he has no connection to the autobiography mentioned in the question.
